content.overview: Related party is s. 2(76). Disclosure is s. 184. Approval of specified contracts is s. 188, with audit-committee approval under s. 177 where that committee exists.
content.glance: Related party is s. 2(76). Disclosure is s. 184. Approval of specified contracts is s. 188, with audit-committee approval under s. 177 where that committee exists.
content.study: Identify the party, the contract type, ordinary-course and arm's length status, thresholds, and the voting exclusion. Listed companies have additional LODR rules. A non-compliant contract is voidable and may require indemnity.
